citation.title: Co-Optimization of Structure and Manufacturable Semi-Continuous Layers for Laminated Composites
citation.authors: Tao Liu, Aoran Lyu, Yongxue Chen, Yu Jiang, Michael Petty, Charlie C. L. Wang

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: The abstract reports laminated composite specimens with up to 43.8% greater stiffness than specimens made with planar fabric plies; it does not establish whether that comparator is a classical optimizer.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: The 43.8% is a stiffness improvement, not a time ratio.
claim.alternatives: The author project page depicts a comparison with NeuralTOMO, which is also a neural method.

baseline.quality_gap: up to 43.8% higher stiffness than planar-fabric-ply counterparts (author project abstract)

notes: Author project page provides abstract, method overview and code link, but its paper link reaches an ACM 403 block. A ResearchGate request page has no full text. The 43.8% comparison may be quality-only; the full text is needed to determine whether a classical optimization baseline exists.
